preconditions.description: The dimensions of the land plot and the desired time are within specified bounds.
The times for flat ground, ascent, and descent are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= height <= 10**6 for row in heights for height in row)
preconditions.description: All height values are positive integers not exceeding 10^6.

postconditions.expression: 1 <= r1 <= n - 2 and 1 <= c1 <= m - 2 and r1 <= r2 <= n and c1 <= c2 <= m
postconditions.description: The selected rectangle is completely contained within the land plot and has at least three squares on each side.

postconditions.expression: abs(ts - t) == min(abs(ts - t) for r1 in range(1, n-1) for c1 in range(1, m-1) for r2 in range(r1+2, n+1) for c2 in range(c1+2, m+1))
postconditions.description: The time taken to pass the selected track is as close to the desired time t as possible.
